During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had a secret '''base''' on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was raided by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] and his squad.
